text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the adoption of a by-law to designate an accessible parking space on the north side of Samson Crescent where parking is permitted for a maximum default period of three hours.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible parking space to operate at all times on the north side of Samson Crescent, between a point 130 metres east of Susan Street and a point 6 metres further east.
